&First = new()
msg("default=" + Trim(Str(&First.Amount)), status)
&First.Amount = 7
&Second = &First
&Second.Amount = 9
msg("alias_first=" + Trim(Str(&First.Amount)), status)
msg("alias_second=" + Trim(Str(&Second.Amount)), status)
&Second = &First.Clone()
&Second.Amount = 11
msg("clone_first=" + Trim(Str(&First.Amount)), status)
msg("clone_second=" + Trim(Str(&Second.Amount)), status)
